result: Priya opened with an owl, but Leo caught a problem before anything was laid: the client already had an owl sign. Priya switched to an elephant facing left. Tom started the trunk, and Priya's first ear landed on his line, so she laid it again. Leo built the spine and checked the high joints, noting the back sat higher than the sketch but still read as an elephant. Maya's legs ran out at the back foot, leaving the belly and both legs open. Then the pad looked empty to Leo, though Priya had been holding it, and some strokes had to be laid again. Tom bridged a gap in the back leg by hand. With time nearly gone, Leo traced the front leg while everyone kept clear. "Hands off everyone, let Leo finish the front leg," Maya wrote. When the start domino fell, 142 of 166 went down, and everyone said elephant.
